findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Chrome 95.0.4638.69)
findings.summary_md: Google's Chrome team shipped 95.0.4638.69 with a fix for CVE-2021-38003, an inappropriate implementation in V8 reported by Clément Lecigne of Google TAG and Samuel Groß of Google Project Zero on 2021-10-26. The advisory states Google was aware that exploits for CVE-2021-38003 existed in the wild at the time of release. This is the vendor advisory for the V8 bug Gen Digital later observed being reused against Sogou Input Method's frozen Chromium 80 engine, a build that predates the fix.

findings.title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog entry for CVE-2021-38003
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2021-38003 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2021-11-03, six days after Google's patch release. The entry describes a bug in Google Chromium V8 where the internal TheHole value can leak to script code via JSON.stringify, causing memory corruption. The listing documents in-the-wild exploitation within a week of the fix, in an engine version Sogou was already embedding with its sandbox and same-origin policy disabled.
